parties.petitioner: M/s Alpine Housing Development Corporation Pvt. Ltd.

summary: Arbitration Section 34 application; pre-2019 amendment provision applicable; concession by counsel not binding if contrary to law; Section 34(2)(a) vs 34(2)(b) interpretation; furnishing proof requirement applies only to grounds under 34(2)(a); Fiza Developers ratio clarified by Emkay Global; 2019 amendment treated as declaratory; additional evidence impermissible except in exceptional circumstances; public policy challenge cannot rest on post-award events or execution difficulties; award not in conflict with public policy.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; respondent's application for adducing additional evidence in Section 34 proceedings rejected; original order refusing additional evidence restored.
